nodes.title: Round 7 (main's hybrid-pilot judgement, defect 4): she never claims she did not hear words that were heard. A heard word or number the note reads as unclear on a card gets an off-format nudge (say back what they said, ask which it is). A reply line claiming not to have heard (sunai nahi diya, couldn't hear you) is caught on any turn with heard words and not marked unclear: rewritten, or the sentence is dropped.

Round 7 (judgement defect 5): a worked example states its problem and givens first (part 1), and says a bracket sum first. A spoken N times A plus B for the content's N × (A + B) is rewritten in code to A plus B, yani A+B, ka N guna (server/brain/brackets.js).

Round 7 (judgement defect 6): on an ungraded turn (her own how-question, no key) a negation of the child's short answer (4 nahi) is caught: rewritten to credit what fits or ask, else the negation is taken out in code.

Round 7 (judgement defect 7): an unanswered card stays the card. A turn spent on the child's own ask to have it again another way (example, story, slower …, read in code) does not bring the card cap closer. An okay right after she taught on that card (hint, re-teach, example) re-poses it plainly, once per card. The card cap and the stall guard still retire a card that gets nothing but non-answers.

md.decisions:
## dc-r7-brain-no-false-not-heard (2026-11-04, stream A Brain)

A child who said "8" heard "I couldn't hear you": a false statement and a small humiliation. The unclear repair is for a garbled line; heard words that do not fit are off-format.

## dc-r7-brain-bracket-givens (2026-11-04, stream A Brain)

"2 times 50 plus 30" before the park was ever described: the child cannot follow a step whose givens were never said, and the spoken bracket is ambiguous. The shape asks for givens first, and code fixes the one ambiguity it can see.

## dc-r7-brain-no-verdict-ungraded (2026-11-04, stream A Brain)

A model never grades. A how-question she invented has no key, so "4 nahi" was a verdict nothing checked. The child probably meant 4 sides.

## dc-r7-brain-card-stays (2026-11-04, stream A Brain)

The card cap (3 pinned turns) counted the turn she spent on the child's own request for an example, so the next "theek hai" retired the card. The pilot's reply then skipped even the answer. A child who asked for help gets to try after it.
